disciplines.name: Brand
disciplines.tagline: A clear identity, built to be used.
disciplines.intro: Define what your business stands for and translate it into a consistent identity across products, places, and channels.

services.name: Strategy
services.description: A practical foundation for your brand’s position, audience, and message.
services.problem: Teams struggle to communicate clearly when the business has no shared position or priorities.
services.outcomes: Helps teams make more consistent decisions about how the brand presents itself.

services.name: Naming
services.description: A structured process for developing and evaluating names for businesses, products, or services.
services.problem: An unclear or forgettable name makes the offer harder to explain and distinguish.
services.outcomes: Provides a focused shortlist for final selection and independent legal clearance.

services.name: Identity
services.description: A visual and verbal system that gives your brand a recognizable expression.
services.problem: Inconsistent design and language make a business harder to recognize across channels.
services.outcomes: Makes it easier for teams to produce consistent, recognizable brand materials.

services.name: Packaging
services.description: Packaging design that communicates the product and organizes essential information.
services.problem: Unclear packaging can hide product benefits and make ranges difficult to navigate.
services.outcomes: Helps customers understand the product and supports more consistent production.

disciplines.name: Digital
disciplines.tagline: Content with a clear job to do.
disciplines.intro: Turn your brand and offer into useful content, coordinated campaigns, and motion for the channels your audience uses.

services.name: Content
services.description: Written and visual content planned around audience needs and business priorities.
services.problem: Publishing without a clear purpose creates disconnected messages and unnecessary production work.
services.outcomes: Gives teams a clearer publishing direction and reusable assets for ongoing communication.

services.name: Social
services.description: A channel-specific system for planning, producing, and evaluating social content.
services.problem: Irregular posting and generic content make it difficult to build a coherent social presence.
services.outcomes: Supports a more consistent social presence and clearer learning from audience response.

services.name: Campaigns
services.description: Coordinated creative and messaging for a defined launch, promotion, or business objective.
services.problem: Disconnected ads and landing pages weaken the path from initial interest to action.
services.outcomes: Creates a coherent campaign experience with a practical basis for testing performance.

services.name: Motion
services.description: Animation and video design that explain ideas and bring brand assets to life.
services.problem: Static materials can struggle to show a process, demonstrate a product, or explain change.
services.outcomes: Helps audiences follow key ideas and gives teams adaptable assets for digital channels.

disciplines.name: Technology
disciplines.intro: Design and develop websites, commerce experiences, and applications around real user tasks and the systems behind them.

services.name: Websites
services.description: Responsive websites that present your offer and guide visitors toward relevant actions.
services.problem: Slow, confusing, or outdated websites make basic information and next steps harder to find.
services.outcomes: Makes your offer easier to explore and gives your team a more manageable publishing platform.

services.name: Commerce
services.description: Online stores that connect product discovery, purchasing, and day-to-day operations.
services.problem: Friction in product navigation, checkout, or order handling can interrupt sales and add manual work.
services.outcomes: Supports a clearer shopping experience and more connected store operations.

services.name: UI/UX
services.description: Research, interaction design, and interface systems built around how people use a product.
services.problem: Unclear navigation and inconsistent interfaces make important tasks difficult to complete.
services.outcomes: Helps teams identify usability problems and make implementation decisions with greater clarity.

services.name: Web Apps
services.description: Browser-based applications that support a defined customer journey or operational workflow.
services.problem: Spreadsheets and disconnected tools become difficult to manage as workflows grow more complex.
services.outcomes: Brings selected workflows into one application with clearer access and information handling.

services.name: APIs
services.description: Interfaces and integrations that let software systems exchange data and trigger actions.
services.problem: Disconnected systems force teams to re-enter information and reconcile conflicting records.
services.outcomes: Can reduce duplicate data entry and make information exchange easier to maintain.

services.name: 3D Web
services.description: Interactive 3D experiences that run in a browser to demonstrate products or environments.
services.problem: Flat images can make spatial details, product configurations, and complex features difficult to understand.
services.outcomes: Gives visitors a more interactive way to inspect details and explore available configurations.

disciplines.name: AI
disciplines.intro: Apply AI where it can support useful work, with clear boundaries, connected information, and human review where needed.

services.name: AI Agents
services.description: AI assistants that use approved tools and information to carry out defined tasks.
services.problem: Teams spend time coordinating repeatable tasks across multiple systems and sources.
services.outcomes: Can reduce routine coordination while keeping consequential actions under human control.

services.name: Automation
services.description: Connected workflows that move information and execute repeatable steps automatically.
services.problem: Manual handoffs delay work and make routine processes dependent on individual follow-up.
services.outcomes: Can reduce manual handling and make routine processes easier to track.

services.name: Knowledge Systems
services.description: Search and question-answering systems built around your organization’s approved information.
services.problem: Useful knowledge is difficult to find when it is spread across documents and internal tools.
deliverables: Search and answer interface with citations
services.outcomes: Helps people locate relevant information and check answers against their sources.

services.name: Voice AI
services.description: Voice interfaces that handle defined conversations and connect them to business workflows.
services.problem: Routine calls can create queues when each interaction requires the same manual steps.
deliverables: Call testing and quality review setup
services.outcomes: Can support routine inquiries while providing a clear route to a person when needed.

services.name: Vision AI
services.description: Image and video analysis for defined tasks such as classification, inspection, or information extraction.
services.problem: Manual visual review becomes slow and inconsistent when teams handle large volumes of material.
services.outcomes: Can help prioritize visual review and process selected material more consistently.

disciplines.name: Analytics
disciplines.intro: Organize your data into useful measures, views, and analysis so teams can understand performance and choose what to improve.

services.name: KPIs
services.description: A focused set of performance measures tied to business objectives and accountable owners.
services.problem: Teams cannot assess progress consistently when metrics have unclear definitions or competing priorities.
services.outcomes: Creates a shared basis for discussing progress and identifying performance gaps.

services.name: Dashboards
services.description: Interactive views that bring relevant business measures into one accessible place.
services.problem: Teams lose time assembling reports and struggle to see changes across disconnected data sources.
services.outcomes: Makes selected performance measures easier to access and review regularly.

services.name: Funnels
services.description: Measurement of the steps people take from first interaction to a defined outcome.
services.problem: Aggregate traffic and sales numbers do not explain where people leave a journey.
services.outcomes: Helps teams locate friction and choose which journey stages to investigate first.

services.name: Forecasts
services.description: Scenario-based estimates of future performance using historical data and explicit assumptions.
services.problem: Planning becomes reactive when teams lack a structured view of possible future demand or performance.
services.outcomes: Supports planning with visible assumptions and uncertainty rather than a single unexplained number.

services.name: Reports
services.description: Recurring reports that explain performance, material changes, and decisions that need attention.
services.problem: Long or inconsistent reports bury the information decision-makers need.
services.outcomes: Reduces recurring reporting effort and makes performance reviews easier to follow.

services.name: Insights
services.description: Focused analysis that investigates a business question and explains what the evidence supports.
services.problem: Teams collect data without a clear explanation of what changed or why it matters.
deliverables: Findings with limitations and next steps
services.outcomes: Helps decision-makers distinguish supported findings from assumptions that need further testing.

services.name: Growth
services.description: A structured program of experiments to improve acquisition, activation, retention, or revenue.
services.problem: Unprioritized ideas consume effort without building clear evidence about what improves performance.
services.outcomes: Helps teams learn which changes are worth extending, adjusting, or stopping.
